description: A painting in a dark, candlelit office. A man in a dark frock coat, waistcoat and top hat leans over an open ledger on a wooden table. A ragged, shabby man in a cap cups his hand to the first man's ear as if whispering. The table holds stacks of papers, a box of index cards and a lit candle. A window with pale light is on the right, and a shadowy third figure stands at the far right edge. Small handwriting is on the papers, but it is not legible. No frame or border is visible.
